instagram_carousel.caption:
Which month for your Bali wedding? There is no single right answer, but there is a smart way to read the calendar.

Our new guide, Best Time to Get Married in Bali by Month, reads each month as a set of trade-offs rather than a verdict.

The seasons:
- Smartraveller says Indonesia's wet season usually runs around October to April, when weather can change quickly and heavy rain can flood roads in Bali.
- May to September sits outside that window, which gives an outdoor ceremony the most room.
- Bali's climate station divides the province into 20 season zones and forecasts each season's start every year, so check the outlook for your venue's zone.

The 2027 dates:
- Nyepi, the Day of Silence, falls on Monday 8 March 2027, beside the Idul Fitri holidays and collective leave.
- April, July, September, October and November have no 2027 national holidays or collective leave.
- December brings collective leave on 24 December, Christmas Day and Isra Mikraj together.

A wet-season plan:
- Choose a venue with a chapel or covered space and a written rain plan.
- Check the covered space holds every guest, for the ceremony and dinner.
- Agree the time the weather call is made, and who makes it.

Weighing up two or three months? Message us to talk it through with a Wedded Advisor. Full guide at the link in bio.
